steps.label: open the Map tab
steps.goal: the Map is the job: everything the other tabs make exists so this one can place it
steps.recovery: if a text field has the keyboard the number types into it: press Escape first

steps.label: arm a piece and place a few
steps.goal: the palette is the left list; the arrows walk it now, Z and C aim the brush, V straightens it, and a click puts the armed piece on the ground
do: walk the palette with up and down -- Shift strides five
aim with Z or C if you like
click two or three spots on the ground
steps.recovery: if a click lands nothing the panel names why -- a click over the interface places nothing, so aim at the ground

steps.label: how does placing feel
steps.goal: the piece verbs act on what is under the cursor: R and T turn it, Y and U tip it over, brackets lift it, H targets inside a stack, X arms removal
do: try a few of the piece verbs on what you placed
then say what grated -- keys, the ghost, the feel of it
steps.recovery: there is nothing to recover here: what grated is the finding

steps.label: generate from the kit's tiles
steps.goal: Cmd+G asks the solver to lay YOUR tiles -- the ones this session authored and repaired -- as a ghosted proposal. Nothing is written yet: keeping it clears unpinned stamps, and your hand placements survive either way
steps.checkpoint: a proposal is on the map
steps.recovery: if nothing appears the panel names why -- no free cells, or a kit whose tiles the grammar refuses

steps.label: read the proposal
steps.goal: a proposal you cannot tell from placed work is a proposal you cannot judge
do: say whether you can tell proposal from placed, and whether the layout reads as rooms
steps.recovery: there is nothing to recover here: an answer of no is the finding

steps.label: keep it
steps.goal: Enter is the door; the solve becomes stamps on the map
steps.recovery: Esc throws it away instead -- if you did that on purpose, say so and generate again

steps.label: save the map
steps.goal: Cmd+S writes the map file; the stamps in it are references to your tiles, so editing a tile later changes every stamp of it
steps.recovery: if the save is refused the panel names why

steps.label: what should change on the Map
steps.goal: the harvest: this tab has the most verbs and the oldest habits
do: say what you want changed about placing, generating, or the door
steps.recovery: there is nothing to recover here: the answer is the finding
